test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If it was Friday on 8 March 1996, then what will be the day of the week on 7 April 2006?
solution:
Given: **8 March 1996 was Friday**.

1996 to 2006 = 10 Years

And, In 10 Years = 2 Leap years and 8 Ordinary Year (because 1996 is counted from 8 March, so 1996 will be treat as ordinary year).

So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days,

And, 8 Ordinary Year has 8 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 8 = 12.

12 odd days → 12/7 = 1 week and 5 odd days.

then, **8 March 2006 will be Friday + 5 = Wednesday**.

Now, the number of days between 8 March 2006 to 7 April 2006

= 23(March) + 7(April) = 30 days.

= 30 days → 30/7 = 4 week and 2 odd day.

So, **7 April 2006 will be Wednesday + 2 = Friday.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
